1.consolidated_definition: ‘Ser vago consuetudinario. No trabajar’, Maura. “¿Ése? Pero si ése no ha dado un tajo en su vida.” Pérez Lozada, La vida es ácida, 1925 .
1.en_consolidated_definition:
To be habitually idle or indolent; not to work.

Note: This definition appears to refer to a colloquialism or idiomatic expression specific to Puerto Rican culture, where "tajo" is used in the context of Pérez Lozada's quote.
